title: Add CONTEXT_OVERFLOW classification to beads-runner
description: Investigation of 3 thirsty-backend UNKNOWN_FAILURE incidents (t4n4/dz47/npqp) found all were context overflow: long Sonnet-4.6 (200K) sessions hitting 'Prompt is too long' (stop_reason=stop_sequence). classify_failure() only catches max_tokens/length, so these fall through to UNKNOWN_FAILURE and get pointlessly retried MAX_RETRIES times (each retry re-overflows at the same point). Fix: stream parser detects result text 'Prompt is too long' + api error variants -> CONTEXT_OVERFLOW signal; classify_failure treats it terminal (before generic); handler mirrors MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS (preserve stream, analysis task on opus, no retries). Analysis task gets salvage guidance: inspect git log for completed phases, re-scope to remaining work only, consider model:opus[1m] or splitting.
close_reason: Implemented: CONTEXT_OVERFLOW classification in run-beads-tasks.sh (detects 'Prompt is too long', mirrors MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS, no pointless retries, salvage-guidance analysis task); new security-reviewer agent template + conditional Step 1b in ios/android/backend wrapup templates redirecting away from built-in /security-review; scaffolder docs updated. Verified against 3 real failure streams; code-reviewed (1 fix applied: model:opus[1m]->model:opus guidance).

title: Add security-reviewer agent + wrapup integration to project-scaffolder
description: Built-in /security-review is a prompt-injection skill: it injects the full git diff into the MAIN conversation (parent_tool_use_id=null), unlike code-reviewer/privacy-reviewer which delegate to isolated agents. At the tail of a long autonomous session this pollutes context (caused t4n4 overflow) and yields a non-independent review. Fix in scaffolder templates: (1) new templates/agents/security-reviewer.md mirroring privacy-reviewer.md (isolated subagent); (2) wrapup templates (ios/android/backend) get a conditional security step mirroring the existing privacy-reviewer pattern that spawns the agent and explicitly redirects away from built-in /security-review (redirect, never bare prohibition); (3) setup-steps.md + init-project/SKILL.md updated to copy/inventory the new agent. Note: existing scaffolded projects (e.g. thirsty-backend) are copies and must re-sync separately.

title: Add tool-error visibility to beads-runner
description: Watchdog visibility shipped in ef0226f; tool-level errors inside the stream are still silent. Add three improvements: (1) scan stream for is_error:true tool_results with pattern-match for high-signal cases (agent-not-found, permission-denied, MCP-unavailable), surface to beads notes + incidents.log + summary. (2) For agent-not-found specifically, send a desktop notification — this caught us with code-reviewer. Record + notify but do NOT change classification or fail the task. (3) Pre-flight env snapshot at startup: pwd, ls .claude/agents, ls .claude/skills, claude/bd versions written to preflight.log + one-line stdout summary, so missing project assets are obvious.
